title.narrative: International Digital Cooperation - Enhanced Data Protection and Data Flows

description.narrative: The action aims to strengthen understanding of the importance of personal data protection for data flows and to enhance the level of data protection among key trading partners in Asia and Latin America. The project will focus on Asia, in particular on Japan and Korea and, to a lesser extent, on India, and on Latin America, with a regional approach complemented with bilateral activities, in particular in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Mexico and Uruguay.
